Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF JOB: 1. AMC should include 12 preventive maintenance visit and 6 breaks down visit to be attended within 72 hrs. from the time of intimation for 2 glove boxes (6 PM & 3 BD for each glove box for 3 years). 2. AMC shall include Glove Box and all its connected accessories 3. Payment will be made on visit basis subject to the completion of all the planned activities for that part icular period. 4. Validity of the AMC will be for 3 years from the date of order placement. 5. Vendor shall execute the AMC in line with the checklist of preventive maintenance and calibration of e quipment as provided by OEM 6. Vendor shall be an OEM / OEM authorized agent for providing AMC services and vendor to submit the a uthorization certificate for the entire AMC period. 7. Vendor shall also provide technical / application support during the AMC period. 8. Vendor shall also take up any process / software related issues exist during the AMC period. 9. Any spares / consumables required will be supplied by HPCL. However, on need basis vendor to arra nge the spares / consumables on chargeable basis.

NOTES TO VENDOR: Vendor has to quote firm & fixed AMC charges for three years with year wise breakup as mentioned below 1) First Year 1st PM Visit for Glove Box-1 2) First Year 2nd PM Visit for Glove Box-1 3) Second Year 1st PM Visit for Glove Box-1 4) Second Year 2nd PM Visit for Glove Box-1 5) Third Year 1st PM Visit for Glove Box-1 6) Third Year 2nd PM Visit for Glove Box-1 7) First Year BD Visit for Glove Box-1 8) Second Year BD Visit for Glove Box-1 9) Third Year BD Visit for Glove Box-1 10) First Year 1st PM Visit for Glove Box-2 11) First Year 2nd PM Visit for Glove Box-2 12) Second Year 1st PM Visit for Glove Box-2 13) Second Year 2nd PM Visit for Glove Box-2 14) Third Year 1st PM Visit for Glove Box-2 15) Third Year 2nd PM Visit for Glove Box-2 16) First Year BD Visit for Glove Box-2 17) Second Year BD Visit for Glove Box-2 18) Third Year BD Visit for Glove Box-2 VALIDITY OF THE ORDER 03 (Three) years from the date of PO. PAYMENT TERMS: i) The vendor needs to raise an invoice after every visit during the AMC period ii) For Preventive maintenance, payment will be made as per lump sum price quoted after completion of r espective preventive maintenance activities. iii) In case of breakdown visits, the payment will be made as per lump sum price quoted for breakdown vis it after the completion of activities. iv) Payment will be made within 30 working days of receipt of the original invoice and service report sign ed by both the parties. PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE / LIQUIDATED DAMANGES (PRC/LD) Not Applicable. JOB TO COMMENCE Applicable as per PO terms and conditions CPBG / RETENTION Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract.
